notes.title: THERE SWINGS A SKULL: GRIM TIDINGS French Build Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Today marks the release of the French Language build of There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings! [/b]

We're pleased to introduce our game to another part of the world - and hope to do more in the future!

notes.title: There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings Update #1!
notes.notes:
Our first patch has released!
Includes:
[list]
[*]Fixed typo on Pyotr day 2
[*]Gave the boys some items so their pockets will not be so woefully empty
[*]Changed Anatoli's movement route In A Certain Situation to clarify his end goal
[*]Added a couple examinables to Pyotr day 1
[/list]
Thanks for the continued support!
